art_direction: 近黑底，银绿双弧稍高置，左窄浅、右高圆底细，下方留白宽阔，各有长奶白反光。
composition_variation: Only two floating matte-gouache crescent eyes: smaller, narrower left; much wider, rounder right. Black centers merge into background. Both arcs share exactly #A3B9AE; each has one long ivory glint. Place both arcs above the midpoint with abundant darkness below. The left stays narrow and shallow; the right is high and rounded with a delicate bottom. No head, brows, mouth, sclera, 3D, glow, text or squared edges.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
